title: Security appliances software versions MX 26.1.4 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new Generally Available MX Security & SD-WAN firmware is now available

Executive summary: This is a Generally Available maintenance release for MX 26.1. It contains fixes across VRF-aware AutoVPN, OSPF route advertisement, IPsec VPN behavior, uplink monitoring and Dashboard visibility, device stability, and Umbrella DNS handling.
It also addresses limited-platform issues on C8455-G2-MX, C8111-G2-MX and C8121-G2-MX, and MX75, MX85, MX95, and MX105 appliances.
Bug fixes - general fixes: Resolved an issue that could cause AutoVPN traffic to be dropped when VRFs were enabled and another MX in the AutoVPN deployment did not yet support VRF-aware traffic. (MX-45434)
Fixed an issue that could cause VPN-enabled static routes exported into OSPF to stop being advertised after the subnet size changed while the same LSA ID was retained. (MX-44944)
Corrected an issue that could briefly disrupt BGP traffic in some IPsec VPN connections over multiple WAN uplinks during IKE reauthentication. (MX-45265)
Resolved an issue that could prevent an MX hub in NAT mode from returning ICMP fragmentation-needed messages for AutoVPN traffic between spokes when the traffic exceeded the VPN MTU. (MX-45345)
Fixed an issue that could cause passthrough uplinks to appear disabled in Dashboard even when link monitoring was up. (MX-46101)
Corrected an issue that could cause incorrect IPv6 loss to be reported on uplinks with no IPv6 address configured when another uplink had IPv6 connectivity. (MX-43875)
Resolved an issue that could cause TCP DNS queries for domains on the Umbrella bypass list to still be redirected to Umbrella. (MX-43099)

Corrected an issue on MX75, MX85, MX95, MX105, MX250, MX450, C8111-G2-MX, C8121-G2-MX, and C8455-G2-MX appliances that could duplicate ICMP error traffic when traffic was routed from one LAN network to another. (MX-44592)
Resolved an issue that could cause appliances with splash pages enabled to restart unexpectedly. (MX-47835)
Resolved a performance issue that could increase packet loss during bursty traffic on some MX 26.1 wired appliances, including C8455-G2-MX. (MX-46407)
Bug fixes - limited platform fixes: Fixed an issue that could cause WAN3 to appear disconnected on C8455-G2-MX appliances after reconfiguring non-contiguous WAN uplinks. (MX-46294)
Corrected an issue that could prevent clients from obtaining an IP address on C8455-G2-MX appliances after changing a LAN port to trunk mode. (MX-46260)
Resolved a performance issue that could delay VLAN configuration on C8455-G2-MX appliances when large VLAN sets were configured. (MX-45408)
Corrected an issue that could prevent Adaptive Policy tags from being applied to egress traffic on C8455-G2-MX, C8111-G2-MX, and C8121-G2-MX appliances. (MX-44796) (MX-45126)
Resolved an issue that could cause C8111-G2-MX and C8121-G2-MX appliances to restart unexpectedly in some AutoVPN configurations. (MX-44975)
Fixed an issue that could cause disabled WAN3 uplinks on MX75, MX85, MX95, and MX105 appliances to appear in Dashboard loss and latency history with 100% loss. (MX-47004)
Corrected an issue that could cause Local Status Page speed and duplex changes to apply to the wrong port on MX75, MX85, MX95, and MX105 appliances. (MX-42557)
Legacy products notice: When configured for this version, Z3(C) devices will run MX 19.2.7.
When configured for this version, MX64(W), MX65(W), MX84, MX100, and vMX100 devices will run MX 18.107.13.
Known issues: When an MX running 26.1.2 or higher is factory reset while offline, the local status page may be unreachable from LAN ports until the appliance can connect to Dashboard and download its configuration. (MX-47727)
Other: The product complies with EN 18031-1:2024 and EN 18031-2: 2024

  • It also addresses limited-platform issues on C8455-G2-MX, C8111-G2-MX and C8121-G2-MX, and MX75, MX85, MX95, and MX105 appliances.

Bug fixes - general fixes

  • Resolved an issue that could prevent an MX hub in NAT mode from returning ICMP fragmentation-needed messages for AutoVPN traffic between spokes when the traffic exceeded the VPN MTU. (MX-45345)

  • Corrected an issue that could cause incorrect IPv6 loss to be reported on uplinks with no IPv6 address configured when another uplink had IPv6 connectivity. (MX-43875)

  • Resolved an issue that could cause TCP DNS queries for domains on the Umbrella bypass list to still be redirected to Umbrella. (MX-43099)

  • Corrected an issue on MX75, MX85, MX95, MX105, MX250, MX450, C8111-G2-MX, C8121-G2-MX, and C8455-G2-MX appliances that could duplicate ICMP error traffic when traffic was routed from one LAN network to another. (MX-44592)

  • Resolved an issue that could cause C8111-G2-MX and C8121-G2-MX appliances to restart unexpectedly in some AutoVPN configurations. (MX-44975)
